description: Angular component for displaying image references with tenant and entity details, including logic for handling system and non-system entities, and fetching tenant data.

classes.name: ImageReferencesComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing and displaying references to images, including tenant and entity details, with support for system and non-system entities.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, loads entity references, and updates UI state based on user authority.

methods.name: isSystem
methods.description: Checks if a tenant ID corresponds to the system tenant (NULL_UUID).

methods.name: hasNonSystemEntities
methods.description: Determines if resource references include entities outside the system tenant.

methods.name: toReferencedEntitiesList
methods.description: Converts resource references into a list of referenced entity info objects with URLs and type names.

methods.name: toReferencedEntitiesEntries
methods.description: Builds an observable that fetches tenant details and organizes referenced entities by tenant.
